explain.say: Your bladder is a stretchy muscle bag that stores urine so you don't have to wee all the time. It runs a cycle: fill, signal, hold, empty, and fill again.

explain.say: Urine trickles in from the kidneys all day through two tubes called ureters. The bladder wall stretches, and stretch sensors in it send messages to the spinal cord and brain.

explain.say: When the signals get strong you feel the urge to wee. Your brain can keep a ring of muscle at the exit, the outer sphincter, squeezed shut until you reach a toilet.

explain.say: When you decide to go, the brain relaxes the sphincters and the bladder wall, called the detrusor muscle, squeezes. Urine flows out through the urethra, and the cycle starts again.

faq.q: How does your bladder know it is full?
faq.a: The bladder wall contains stretch sensors. As urine fills it, the wall stretches and the sensors send stronger and stronger signals to the brain, which you feel as needing to wee.
asks: Tell me about the full signal
Why do I feel I need to wee?

faq.q: How can you hold in a wee?
faq.a: A ring of muscle at the bladder exit, the external urethral sphincter, is under your control. The brain keeps it squeezed shut until you choose to let go.
asks: Tell me about the brain holding on

faq.q: How much can the bladder hold?
faq.a: An adult bladder usually holds about 400 to 600 millilitres. People typically start to feel the urge at around 200 to 300 millilitres.

faq.q: Why can't babies hold their wee?
faq.a: In babies the emptying reflex runs on its own through the spinal cord. As children grow, the brain learns to read the full signal and control the outer sphincter, which is what toilet training builds on.
asks: How do children learn to control their bladder?

faq.a: The ureters are two thin tubes, one from each kidney, that carry urine down to the bladder. Muscle waves in their walls push urine along.
asks: How does urine get to the bladder?

facts: The adult bladder typically holds about 400 to 600 millilitres of urine.
The bladder wall muscle is called the detrusor muscle.
